Q1: Which branch should this fix be planned and implemented against? The failing test exists only on PR #6653's head branch.
Choices:
A. `ai/issue-6631`, the head branch of PR #6653. The fix lands on the PR, so its CI re-runs with the corrected test. (RECOMMENDED)
B. The default branch (`main`). **Note:** the test is not on `main`, so this gives a no-op implementation unless PR #6653 merges first.
C. Fix nothing here: close this issue and let PR #6653's own review/autofix loop repair the test from the failing CI check-run it already reads.
